comment: The README gives this module a mute button with a long-press solo turning green; the code configures a plain two-state mute with a red lamp, and the long-press solo belongs to the DC2 strip. The README also says the master clamps its output to 12V: the clamp is applied to the chain sum before the level knob, so a knob above 0dB takes the output past 12V. While muted the output jacks are left unwritten rather than zeroed, so they hold their last voltage.
